question: Which event is regarded as a major factor in the unification of Germany in the Nineteenth Century?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 48/2026 (Special Branch Asst, 16 May 2026). The correct answer is The Franco-Prussian War.

question: Which among the following country joined along with Indian army to conduct Military exercise called ‘nomadic elephant’ at Meghalaya on July 2024?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 141/2025 (HST Social Science, 4 Nov 2025). The correct answer is Mangolia.

question: Find the two incorrect statements about Reformation movement in Christianity : (I) In 1516 a German monk called Martin Luther launched a campaign against Catholic Church (II) This movement is also known as Protestant Reformation (III) In Switzerland Luther’s ideas were popularized by Ulrich Zwingli (IV) In Spain Ignatius Loyola set up the Society of Jesus in 1541
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 106/2025 (High School Teacher, 20 Aug 2025). The correct answer is Only (I) and (IV) 3.

question: Who served as the Chief Guest at the Republic Day celebrations in India in 2025?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 50/2025 (Divisional Accountant, 10 May 2025). The correct answer is Prabowo Subianto.

question: The Co-operative movement in England was supported in its early stage by a Co-operative periodical named ‘The Co-operator’. Who among the following founded it ?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 044/2024 (Assistant, 23 Apr 2024). The correct answer is dr. William King.

question: The Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (FCTC) is considered a landmark in global public health governance because it :
options: mandates all member states to ban tobacco production
introduces binding international legal obligations to reduce tobacco demand and supply
recommends voluntary national programs for tobacco cessation
establishes a global fund for tobacco-related disease treatment
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 160/2025 (Dental Assistant Surgeon, 28 Nov 2025). The correct answer is introduces binding international legal obligations to reduce tobacco demand and supply.

question: Match the following : List – A List – B (Asian Countries) (Geographical Locations) i. Singapore a. Southern asia ii. Jordan b. East asia iii. South Korea c. South East asia iv. Bhutan d. Western asia
options: i – c ii – d iii – b iv – a
i – d ii – c iii – a iv – b
i – c ii – d iii – a iv – b
i – a ii – d iii – b iv – c
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 63/2025 (Technical Assistant Gr II, 12 Jun 2025). The correct answer is i – c ii – d iii – b iv – a.

question: Which of the following is/are the work of yuval Noah Harari ? i. Homo deus : a Brief History of Tomorrow ii. Humankind : a Hopeful History iii. Sapiens : a Brief History of Humankind iv. 21 lessons for the 21st century
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 63/2025 (Technical Assistant Gr II, 12 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only i, iii and iv.

question: Chronologically arrange the following events /incidents. i. Bhopal Gas Tragedy ii. Birth of first test tube baby iii. Tiananmen Square massacre iv. disintegration of USSR
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 63/2025 (Technical Assistant Gr II, 12 Jun 2025). The correct answer is ii, i, iii, iv.

question: Which Sustainable development Goal aims at making cities and urban settlements inclusive, safe , resilient and sustainable ?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 62/2025 (Assistant Town Planner, 11 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Goal no. 11.
